body:
We see the below components of the server:v1.28.0 image have some vulnerabilities. 

alpine://3.22:libcrypto3:3.5.0-r0 - **CVE-2025-4575**
go://go.temporal.io/server:1.18.1-0.20230217005328-b313b7f58641 - **CVE-2023-3485**
go://go.temporal.io/api:1.18.1 - **CVE-2025-1243**
go://golang.org/x/net:0.34.0 - **CVE-2025-22870**
go://github.com/golang/go:1.24.1 - **CVE-2025-4673**
go://google.golang.org/grpc:1.56.3 - **CVE-2024-7246**
go://go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/google.golang.org/grpc/otelgrpc:0.36.4 - **CVE-2023-47108**
go://golang.org/x/crypto:0.32.0 - **CVE-2025-22869**
go://golang.org/x/oauth2:0.7.0 - **CVE-2025-22868**
go://github.com/golang-jwt/jwt/v4:4.5.1 - **CVE-2025-30204**

Please help us with a docker image without these vulnerabilities.

comments.body: We will look into this, thanks for reporting.
Can you please expedite on this? So, that we can plan accordingly on the remediation.
Please let us know if there are any progress on these on this vulnerability fix. Can we get a timeline on when we can have an image?
Can we get a timeline on when we can have an image?
Can we get a timeline on when we can have an image?

I can see in the 1.29.0's release page that components will be removed in the 1.30.0.
Can we have an timeline of that?

This is addressed in upcoming OSS v1.30 release that will happen in early February:
* golang.org/x/net upgraded to v0.47.0 (fixes CVE-2025-22870)
* google.golang.org/grpc upgraded to v1.72.2 (fixes CVE-2024-7246)
* go://go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/google.golang.org/grpc/otelgrpc upgraded to v0.59.0 (fixes CVE-2023-47108)
* golang.org/x/crypto upgraded to v0.45.0 (fixes CVE-2025-22869)
* golang.org/x/oauth2 upgraded to v0.28.0 (fixes CVE-2025-22868)
 * github.com/golang-jwt/jwt/v4 upgraded to v4.5.2 (fixes CVE-2025-30204)
 * Go upgraded to 1.25.5 (fixes CVE-2025-4673, CVE-2025-22871)
@simvlad @yiminc Please let me know the revised date for the 1.30 release.

The following CVEs have been addressed in `temporalio/server:1.29.4`:

- CVE-2025-15467 (CRITICAL, libcrypto3) - fixed
- CVE-2025-22869 (HIGH, golang.org/x/crypto) - fixed
- CVE-2025-30204 (HIGH, golang-jwt) - fixed
- CVE-2024-7246 (HIGH, grpc) - fixed
- CVE-2025-4673 (HIGH, stdlib) - fixed
- CVE-2025-22871 (HIGH, stdlib) - fixed
- CVE-2025-1243 (LOW, go.temporal.io/api) - fixed

The remaining CVEs (CVE-2025-22870, CVE-2023-47108, CVE-2025-22868) trace back to the bundled `tctl` binary, which is archived and will not receive updates. `tctl` has been removed from images starting in 1.30.1.

title: v1.28.0 vulnerabilities
